subject: Legacy Bank: Resilience & audit evidence request — initial Q&A
messages:
From: Samantha Liu <s.liu@legacybank.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@legacybank.com>
Date: Fri, 2 Oct 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Resilience questionnaire and evidence request — scope clarification

Hi Irene,

Thanks for the quick intro yesterday. Legacy Bank is kicking off our third-party resilience assessment and we received Redwood's RFI responses last week. A few clarifications before we validate the control evidence:

- Can you confirm the typical RPO/RTO for customer-managed workloads versus hosted API (token-generation flows)?
- We need the most recent SOC 2 report or a summary of controls and any outstanding exceptions. If SOC is not available, please point to alternative attestations.
- Evidence for disaster recovery exercises (last full failover test date, participants, and runbook used).
- Retention period and format for audit logs; we require the retention policy and an example log schema.

Procurement would like an initial packet and a mapping to our FFIEC-style questionnaire by Friday EOD Oct 4 to keep internal review on schedule. If some artifacts are restricted, tell us which items require an NDA/secure transfer to proceed.

Thanks — happy to jump on a 30-min call if easier.

Samantha Liu
Director, Third-Party Risk
Legacy Bank

--
Attachment: questionnaire-extract.pdf (ref)

From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>
To: Samantha Liu <s.liu@legacybank.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Procurement Team <procurement@legacybank.com>
Date: Fri, 2 Oct 2026 10:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Resilience questionnaire and evidence request — scope clarification

Samantha —

Appreciate the clear list. Quick plan and who owns what below so we hit Oct 4 for the initial mapping: 

- RPO/RTO: Marcus to confirm SLA tiers and measured medians for hosted API and the Dedicated offering (Marcus).
- SOC 2 / attestations: Monica will surface the latest auditor letter and a redacted SOC2 summary (Monica).
- DR exercises & runbook: I'll attach a short runbook summary and provide the date of the last full DR exercise.
- Audit logs: we'll include a retention table and sample schema; if detailed logs are required we can deliver via secure Box transfer.

Deliverables planned by COB Oct 4 (initial index + key artifacts): FFIEC-Response-Index_v1.xlsx, runbook-summary.pdf, control-mapping.csv. Full artifacts to follow via Box transfer (BX-98421) where necessary.

If you want us to skip the initial index and go straight to a secure package, tell us and we'll prioritize that. Otherwise we'll send the index + summaries first.

I'll also schedule a 30-minute sync Monday (Oct 5) to walk through any redlines.

Thanks,

Irene Choi
Head of Sales, Enterprise | Redwood Inference
irene.choi@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0123

--
Attachments: runbook-summary.pdf (summary), FFIEC-Response-Index_v1.xlsx (index)

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
To: Samantha Liu <s.liu@legacybank.com>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Procurement Team <procurement@legacybank.com>
Date: Sun, 4 Oct 2026 16:13:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Resilience questionnaire and evidence request — scope clarification

Samantha / team —

Following up with the initial control mapping (attached: control-mapping.csv). A few specifics inline: 

- RPO/RTO: For hosted API (standard tier) we report median observed RPO ~0s (stateless requests) and RTO for failover measured at 3–7 minutes for endpoint re-attachment under our multi-region routing. Dedicated Reserved pools have configurable RTO (1–15 minutes) depending on cross-region replication settings. I put the measured windows into the index.
- DR test: last full failover drill was 2026-06-21 (planned cross-region traffic cutover, read/write degraded for ~12 minutes during validation). Runbook used is the attached summary; full runbook available via Box transfer.
- Logs: retention policy default is 365 days; can be extended to meet contractual needs. We store structured request/response trace logs with obfuscated PII; the schema sample is included in the control CSV.

We will prepare the secure package (BoxTransferID: BX-98421) with redacted SOC2 summary, control evidence (signed attestations), and anonymized log extracts by Oct 8. If Audit needs raw logs beyond anonymized schema, let us know the exact time window and justification and we'll coordinate secure transfer + NDA if required.

Regards,

Marcus Lin
Director, Platform Reliability | Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.ai

--
Attachment: control-mapping.csv

From: Joseph Sullivan <jsullivan@auditco.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Cc: Samantha Liu <s.liu@legacybank.com>, Procurement Team <procurement@legacybank.com>
Date: Tue, 6 Oct 2026 09:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Resilience questionnaire and evidence request — scope clarification

Irene / Marcus —

Thanks for the quick answers. A couple of audit follow-ups so we can scope our evidence requests: 

- Can you confirm encryption-at-rest key management model (customer-provided CMKs vs Redwood-managed keys) and whether HSM-backed KMS is used for customer CMK wrapping?
- Confirm whether system and application logs are immutable once written and the mechanism (WORM, object-lock, append-only storage).
- For the DR exercise on 2026-06-21: any post-mortem notes or lessons learned that changed runbook steps? Audit will want to see at least summary notes.

If possible, please attach a short KMS integration summary and a log-retention/export example.

Joe Sullivan
Senior IT Auditor | Sullivan & Partners
jsullivan@auditco.com

--

From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>
To: Samantha Liu <s.liu@legacybank.com>, Joseph Sullivan <jsullivan@auditco.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Procurement Team <procurement@legacybank.com>
Date: Tue, 6 Oct 2026 12:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Resilience questionnaire and evidence request — scope clarification

Joe / Samantha —

See the attached artifacts and short answers below; we've packaged the fuller evidence in Box (BX-98421) and shared the secure link with your procurement team. If you need a data-transfer agreement in addition to the NDA, Procurement has a template ready.

- KMS model: Redwood offers both Redwood-managed keys (default) and customer-managed keys (bring-your-own, via Cloud KMS integration). Customer CMKs are wrapped by an HSM-backed KMS; we support AWS KMS and key import for on-prem HSMs. Summary attached (kms-integration-summary.txt).
- Log immutability: Primary write-once policy is implemented via append-only object-store with object-lock; we retain tamper-evident metadata and support WORM policies for audit windows. See audit-logs-retention.csv for retention windows and export formats.
- DR post-mortem: The 2026-06-21 run exposed a coordination gap for DNS TTL during region cutover; runbook step 4.2 was updated to add pre-cutover DNS TTL validation and an automated TTL-check. Summary included in runbook-summary.pdf.

Next steps:
- Marcus will initiate the Box transfer by Oct 7 and confirm access tickets.
- Monica will link the redacted SOC2 summary into the secure package.
- Irene will schedule a 30-minute call for Oct 12 to walk through control mappings and outstanding items.

If you need any specific extracts for a particular time window, tell Marcus the window and purpose and we'll pull anonymized traces for audit review.

Best,

Irene Choi
Head of Sales, Enterprise | Redwood Inference
irene.choi@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0123

--
Attachments: audit-logs-retention.csv, kms-integration-summary.txt
